$description: Octant design tokens in the Design Tokens Community Group format. Generated by `bun run tokens:export` from apps/web/src/styles/octant.css, apps/web/src/styles/octant-bridge.css, apps/web/src/styles.css, apps/web/src/styles/surface.css, packages/theme/src/tokens.ts. $value is the dark default; the light value is in $extensions["com.octant"].light. A token's key is its CSS custom property name without the leading dashes.

color-status.$description: Status: success, warning, danger and diff colours
